{{include reference="XWiki.LiveTableResultsMacros" /}} {{velocity wiki="false"}} ## Same results as XWiki.LiveTableResults, except that the CVE identifier is displayed as a link to its CVE record. ## Advisories without CVE identifier keep the default empty value, instead of a link without target. ## Once disclosed, an advisory is published on a new page, and the original page holds a redirect to it: the original ## pages are skipped so that each advisory is listed once. The subquery selects a document name since, without ## programming right, a query can only select some document fields, and no object field. ## An advisory can impact several packages, each described by its own impacted package object, while the live table ## macros display the values of the first object of a class only. So, for each advisory: ## * the "packageId" cell lists all its impacted packages, each with a line for its affected version ranges and a line ## for its patched versions, displayed as badges colored after their meaning; ## * the "patchedVersions" cell lists the patched versions of all its impacted packages, each version once. #if ($xcontext.action == 'get' and "$!request.outputSyntax" == 'plain')
